name: Easy Maintenance Mode and Coming Soon
author: Syed Tarikul Islam

sections.description:
Easy Maintenance Mode is a lightweight and user-friendly plugin that allows you to enable a maintenance mode page on your WordPress website.
It is perfect for when you need to perform updates, redesign your site, or make other changes without disrupting the user experience.

Key Features:
✔ Enable or disable maintenance mode with a single click.
✔ Fully customizable maintenance page (logo, background, message, and more).
✔ Option to allow logged-in users to bypass maintenance mode.
✔ Responsive and mobile-friendly design.
✔ SEO-friendly with optional meta tags.
✔ Multilingual-ready.

No coding required – just install, activate, and customize! 🚀

Support

For support, visit https://tarikul.blog or contact via support@tarikul.blog.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file and upload it to your WordPress website.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the downloaded zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Once installed, click Activate.
  5. Navigate to Settings → Easy Maintenance Mode to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I enable maintenance mode?

Go to Settings → Easy Maintenance Mode, and toggle the switch to “Enable Maintenance Mode.”

Can I customize the maintenance page?

Yes! You can customize the message, background image, logo, and colors from the settings page.

Will administrators still have access to the website?

Yes, logged-in administrators can view the website normally while maintenance mode is active.

Is this plugin SEO-friendly?

Yes! The maintenance page sends a 503 Service Unavailable status code to search engines, indicating that the website is temporarily down.
